issues.issue: The rule says to use the Statement of Activities to identify county Local lines. p2 shows charges for services of 96,355 (general government 71,904, public safety 24,451; public works 0, so none of it is in the Road Fund). The only other Local amounts are non-major 5,581 and ARP 119, so at least 90,655 (about 54%) of the General Fund's Local 166,657 is charges for services. It should be 'charges for services/fees' (detail 'other charges for services' or 'fees of office') with review, not 'other'.

p4 shows Road Fund Local 12,118 plus Sale of surplus 79,674 = 91,792. Sale of surplus is 87% of the line, so its dominant category is 'sale of assets' (detail 'sale of assets'), with review naming the mix. The extractor's own review note identifies this but leaves the line in 'other'.
An ARP fund holding only a cash balance with no spending; 119 is almost certainly interest, so it is probably 'investment income'.

Preservation and modernization funds receive register-of-deeds recording fees, and p2 shows general government charges for services. This is probably 'charges for services/fees' (detail 'fees of office').

STOP program receipts are fees paid by traffic-offense participants, and p2 shows public safety charges for services of 24,451. This is probably 'charges for services/fees' (or 'fines and forfeitures'), not 'other'.
A 3-dollar Local receipt in a capital projects fund is very likely interest ('investment income').
